_about: Penalties the commissioner applies outside of games. Sleeper does not log them, so they live here. Rule: every member must post a league note once a year; if you don't, the commissioner takes FAAB. Each instance is one penalty (config tegridy.weights.missed_league_note). These were first spotted as FAAB that Sleeper counts as used but the transaction log doesn't explain; faab_taken is per instance. Only status 'confirmed' entries count toward Tegridy Factor.

entries.note: Sleeper shows $25 more FAAB used than the log explains, the same size as the confirmed penalties, but this owner was not named. Not counted until confirmed.
Sleeper shows $20 more FAAB used than the log explains, not a $25 multiple. Not counted until confirmed.
